```{r}
#| label: inject-mob-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (mob_ready_dt) {
  mob_for_js <- mob_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      code  = code_commune,
      n     = mob_n_actifs,
      loc   = mob_pct_emploi_local,
      voi   = mob_pct_voiture,
      tc    = mob_pct_tc,
      velo  = mob_pct_velo,
      pied  = mob_pct_pied,
      dest  = mob_top_dest_code,
      flux  = mob_top_dest_flux
    )
  emit_table("mobData", mob_for_js)
  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.mobPalette = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$green)), ';\n',
      'window.mobFields = ', '{"mob_pct_voiture": {"key": "voi", "title": "Voiture, % des actifs occupés", "unit": "%", "digits": 1, "scale": "quantile"}, "mob_pct_tc": {"key": "tc", "title": "Transports en commun, %", "unit": "%", "digits": 1, "scale": "quantile"}, "mob_pct_velo": {"key": "velo", "title": "Vélo, %", "unit": "%", "digits": 1, "scale": "quantile"}, "mob_pct_emploi_local": {"key": "loc", "title": "Emploi dans la commune, %", "unit": "%", "digits": 1, "scale": "quantile"}}', ';\n',
      'window.mobRecolor = function(field) {\n',
      '  var f = window.mobFields[field];\n',
      '  CMap.recolor({ get: function (c) { var r = window.mobData[c]; return r ? r[f.key] : null; },\n',
      '    scale: f.scale, palette: window.mobPalette,\n',
      '    legend: { title: f.title, unit: f.unit, digits: f.digits, naLabel: f.na } });\n',
      '};\n',
      'window.updateMobPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("mob-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var d = window.mobData[code];\n',
      '  // Lookup nom + département : essaie communeLookup (page Elections), sinon fpcNames/fpcDepts (cette page).\n',
      '  var elec = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var nom  = elec ? elec.nom_commune : (window.communeNames && window.communeNames[code] ? window.communeNames[code].nom : code);\n',
      '  var dept;\n',
      '  if (elec) { dept = elec.libelle_dept + " (" + elec.code_dept + ")"; }\n',
      '  else if (window.communeNames && window.communeNames[code]) { dept = "Dépt " + window.communeNames[code].dept; }\n',
      '  else { dept = ""; }\n',
      '  if (!d) { el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + (dept ? dept + " · " : "") + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Pas de données mobilité INSEE.</div>\'; return; }\n',
      '  function fmt(x) { if (x == null) return "—"; return Number(x).toFixed(1); }\n',
      '  function fmtInt(x) { return (x == null) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("fr-FR"); }\n',
      '  var destNom = window.communeNames && window.communeNames[d.dest] ? window.communeNames[d.dest].nom : d.dest;\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + (dept ? dept + " · " : "") + code + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Actifs occupés (RP 2019)</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Total pondéré</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmtInt(d.n) + \'</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Emploi local</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.loc) + \' %</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Mode de transport principal</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Voiture</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.voi) + \' %</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Transports en commun</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.tc) + \' %</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Vélo</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.velo) + \' %</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Marche</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.pied) + \' %</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    (d.dest && d.dest !== code ? \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Top destination</h4><div class="cp-kvs"><div class="cp-kv"><span>\' + destNom + \' (\' + d.dest + \')</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmtInt(d.flux) + \' actifs</span></div></div></div>\' : "");\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-mob
if (mob_ready_dt) {
  vals0 <- mob_data |> dplyr::transmute(code_commune, value = mob_pct_voiture)
  st_mob <- cmap_breaks(vals0$value[vals0$code_commune %in% com_metro_only$code], "quantile")
  m <- cmap_choropleth(com_metro_only, dep_metro, vals0, palette = PAL$green,
                       legend_title = "Voiture, % des actifs occupés", unit = "%", digits = 1L,
                       scale = "quantile", breaks = st_mob)
  cmap_on_render(m, cmap_page_hooks(
    "mob", "updateMobPanel", "mob-content", "mob-ind", "mobRecolor", "mob_pct_voiture",
    ctx = list(ctx_spec("mob_pct_voiture", "Voiture", "%", 1L), ctx_spec("mob_pct_tc", "Transports en commun", "%", 1L),
               ctx_spec("mob_pct_velo", "Vélo", "%", 1L), ctx_spec("mob_pct_pied", "Marche", "%", 1L),
               ctx_spec("mob_pct_emploi_local", "Emploi dans la commune", "%", 1L)),
    extra_pick = "  if (window.fpcRender) window.fpcRender(code);\n"))
} else {
  htmltools::HTML("<p class='js-loading'>MOBPRO non chargé. Lancer Rscript scripts/14_mobilite.R.</p>")
}
```
:::

## Row {height="28%"}

::: {.card title="Flux de la commune sélectionnée · top 5 entrants + top 5 sortants"}
```{r}
#| label: inject-fpc-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
# Les 283 000 lignes de flux ne sont plus dans le HTML : assets/data/mobilite_flows.json
# (généré par R/build_web_assets.R) est téléchargé au premier clic, puis mis en cache.
cat('<script>\n',
    'window.fpcIndex = null;\n',
    'window.fpcLoad = function () {\n',
    '  if (!window.fpcP) window.fpcP = CMap.getJSON(CMap.base + "data/mobilite_flows.json").then(function (t) {\n',
    '    var ix = {};\n',
    '    for (var i = 0; i < t.c.length; i++) {\n',
    '      var e = ix[t.c[i]] || (ix[t.c[i]] = { "in": [], out: [] });\n',
    '      e[t.d[i] ? "out" : "in"].push({ cnt: t.k[i], flux: t.f[i], rang: t.r[i] });\n',
    '    }\n',
    '    window.fpcIndex = ix; return ix;\n',
    '  });\n',
    '  return window.fpcP;\n',
    '};\n',
    'window.fpcRender = function (code) {\n',
    '  var canvas = document.getElementById("fpc-canvas");\n',
    '  if (!canvas) return;\n',
    '  if (!window.fpcIndex) { canvas.innerHTML = \'<div class="js-loading">Chargement des flux\u2026</div>\'; }\n',
    '  window.fpcLoad().then(function (ix) { window.fpcDraw(code, ix[code] || ix[CMap.plmCity(code)]); });\n',
    '};\n',
    'window.fpcDraw = function (code, d) {\n',
    '  var canvas = document.getElementById("fpc-canvas");\n',
    '  var N = window.communeNames || {};\n',
    '  var nom = N[code] ? N[code].nom : code;\n',
    '  var esc = CMap.esc;\n',
    '  if (!d) { canvas.innerHTML = \'<div class="js-loading">Pas de flux significatif dans MOBPRO pour <strong>\' + esc(nom) + "</strong> (" + code + ").</div>"; return; }\n',
    '  var maxFlux = 0;\n',
    '  ["in", "out"].forEach(function (dir) { (d[dir] || []).forEach(function (r) { if (r.flux > maxFlux) maxFlux = r.flux; }); });\n',
    '  function col(items, title) {\n',
    '    items = (items || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.rang - b.rang; });\n',
    '    var h = \'<div class="fpc-col"><div class="fpc-title">\' + esc(title) + "</div>";\n',
    '    if (!items.length) h += \'<div class="dvf-empty">Aucun flux significatif.</div>\';\n',
    '    items.forEach(function (r) {\n',
    '      var w = maxFlux > 0 ? 100 * r.flux / maxFlux : 0, c = N[r.cnt] || { nom: r.cnt, dept: "" };\n',
    '      h += \'<div class="fpc-row"><div class="fpc-line"><span>\' + esc(c.nom) + \' <span class="fpc-dept">(\' + esc(c.dept) + \')</span></span><span class="cp-num">\' +\n',
    '           CMap.fmt(r.flux, 0) + \'</span></div><div class="cp-bar"><div class="cp-bar-fill" style="width:\' + w.toFixed(1) + \'%;background:var(--ink-2)"></div></div></div>\';\n',
    '    });\n',
    '    return h + "</div>";\n',
    '  }\n',
    '  canvas.innerHTML = \'<div class="fpc-cols">\' +\n',
    '    col(d["in"], "Top 5 entrants : résidents d\\u2019ailleurs qui viennent travailler à " + nom) +\n',
    '    col(d.out, "Top 5 sortants : résidents de " + nom + " qui partent travailler") + "</div>";\n',
    '};\n',
    '</script>\n', sep = "")
```

```{=html}
<div id="fpc-canvas" class="fpc-canvas">
  <div class="js-loading">
    <strong>Cliquez une commune sur la carte</strong> pour voir ses 5 plus gros flux entrants
    (résidents d'ailleurs qui viennent y travailler) et ses 5 plus gros flux sortants (résidents qui en partent).
    <br>Source : MOBPRO 2019, Paris, Lyon et Marseille consolidées.
  </div>
</div>
```
